_template_notes.about: Template for op25-docker. Change the passwords and match udp_port to cfg.json, then save (restarts icecast + streams). Full walkthrough: docs/SETUP.md.
_template_notes.icecast: Change source_password / admin_password / supervisor_password from the defaults. listener_auth true means listeners must use an account from listen.json.
_template_notes.streams: One entry per Icecast mount. 'udp_port' must match the channel 'destination' port in cfg.json. 'mount' is the listening URL path (e.g. /primary.mp3), 'codec' is mp3 or aac, 'bitrate_kbps' sets encoder quality.

streams.name: primary
streams.icecast_description: Live P25 Phase 1/2 trunked scanner audio
